name: Sports
summary: Live scores, schedules, standings and players across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college & soccer — by voice
description: Your live sports companion across every major league — NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college football & basketball, and soccer (EPL/UCL/MLS). Ask what games are on, check live scores and box scores, follow your team, read standings, look up any player, and get the latest headlines — in native cards you can tap through. It knows when a league is off-season. No setup and no login: it works the moment you install it.

tools.name: sports_scores
tools.title: Live scores
tools.description: Live and recent scores as a tappable native scoreboard (tap a game for the box score). "What games are on", "NFL scores", "did the Lakers win". Read-only.

league.description: Which league: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, wnba, cfb (college football), mcbb (college basketball), epl/ucl/mls (soccer). Inferable from a team name (ambiguous names resolve to the in-season league).

team.description: Optional team to focus on, e.g. "49ers", "Lakers".

date.description: Optional day YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today / current week.

tools.name: sports_game
tools.title: Box score
tools.description: Full detail for one game — score by quarter, leaders, betting line, live win probability. "How did the Chiefs game go", "box score". Give a team or a game id. Read-only.

league.description: Which league: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, wnba, cfb (college football), mcbb (college basketball), epl/ucl/mls (soccer). Inferable from a team name (ambiguous names resolve to the in-season league).

team.description: A team in the game, e.g. "Chiefs".

game_id.description: ESPN event id from a sports_scores result (optional).

tools.name: sports_schedule
tools.title: Schedule
tools.description: Upcoming games. "What games are on tonight", "when do the Warriors play next", "NBA schedule". With a team, that team's schedule; without one, the league slate. Read-only.
